name: dsh-html-experience
description: DSH plugin: turn one experience-library document into a self-contained HTML reading page with style presets

scripts.demo: node bin/html-experience.js --doc ../../experiences/dsh-creator-mode/dsh-model-architecture-visualization.md --style paper --out demo/dsh-model-architecture-visualization.paper.html --force --prompt '读者第一次用 DSH 创造模式做插件：先看清单契约和验收，再决定怎么改提示词。'
